strings: m_c loudly complains to r_c0 about the flares and spots that now take up {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision, leaving {PRONOUN/m_c/object} unable to properly see at all.
After waking up and stepping out of the den, m_c is hissing at the light and how it burns in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes over the snow sparkles.
m_c talks to a Clanmate about how the snow in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision is catching the light too much and turning into flares.
